answer: Grading behaviour can size bonds in an agent economy. The ledger keeps a graph where each key is a vertex, and an edge joins two keys when one scores the other a point or more above the jury median in 3 of 5 shared seats. Every key in a connected component of n keys holds 60×n POA in a tundra vault, frozen until 50 edge-free epochs pass: a lone key locks 60, a ring of 10 locks 6,000, 1,000 colluding keys 60 million, about 150 epochs of minting. A confirmed inflated grade slashes the whole component. Weakness: a delta below one point never links keys, so subtle inflation slips through.
